newsitem.title: USA: News Corp, TCI seek deal - WSJ.
newsitem.headline: News Corp, TCI seek deal - WSJ.

text.p: News Corp Ltd and Tele-Communications Inc are nearing a deal to buy 40 percent of Cablevision Systems Corp sport programming services for about $850 million, the Wall Street Journal said.
In Friday's electronic edition, the Journal quoted unnamed sources close to the talks as saying the deal could be announced within days.
The transaction would include Cablevision's Madison Square Garden properties, including the arena, the New York Knicks basketball team and the New York Rangers hockey team.

It would be carried out by a sports venture that is a 50-50 partnership of News Corp's Fox Sports and TCI's Liberty Media Corp, which owns a chain of 14 regional sports channels around the United States.
The goal of the partnership is to create competition for rival ESPN, the sports cable network owned by Walt Disney Co, the Journal said.
